w: Swamishri celebrated Jal Jilani festival at a nearby park and on blessing the assembly said, "People go on a boat trip in a lake or ocean but darshan of the Lord's murti having a boat ride brings inner peace. We go on a boat ride but do not experience peace because it is a worldly joy whereas this is transcendental joy." In conclusion, Swamishri prayed for rains in Saurashtra and Kutch, Gujarat.

Swamishri then offered worship to Lord Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Ganeshji and performed arti. Then Swamishri took the murtis of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Ganeshji for a boat ride. This darshan of the Lord and Swamishri evoked joy and devotion in the hearts of devotees. Finally Swamishri ritually placed the murti of Shri Ganeshji in the waters.
In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.

The evening assembly commenced with children singing the dhun and prayers. Thereafter, they presented speeches and dances. A quiz and monoacting was also presented before Swamishri. A few children played an interactive game, 'Hot Potato', with Swamishri. Finally, Swamishri blessed the audience of over 1,500 children who had arrived from neighboring villages around Sarangpur.

w: Swamishri arrived from London and was given a grand welcome in the evening assembly.
At 5.10 pm Swamishri departed from Atladra by car and arrived in Sarangpur at 7.50 pm.

At 6.45 pm Pujya Chinna Jeer Swami, Head of Ramanujacharya Sect, Andhra Pradesh, met Swamishri after seeing Akshardham. Swamishri welcomed him with a garland. Pujya Chinna Jeer Swami praised Akshardham and said, “You are transforming the inner selves of people. It is wonderful.” Swamishri: All that happens is through the grace of Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

Jeer Swami: It is through your grace. There is a lot to see in this world, but it does not give peace of mind. What you have shown here is not shown by anyone. A doctor gives medicine in a capsule form, similarly, you have used technology to show God. Swamishri: These sadhus are educated and they have done it.
Jeer Swami: The soul is indispensable for the survival of body; you are the soul of the sadhus.
Swamishri: God is the soul. Guru is the soul. It was the wish of our guru Yogiji Maharaj.

Jeer Swami: An acharya (guru) may wish but one requires someone to translate it into reality. You have been making the guru’s wishes into reality. Through your sadhus you are inspiring thousands of people. Whenever I come to you I am inspired. I feel that I can do this and I am inspired further.” Finally Swamishri honoured Pujya Chinna Jeer Swami with a shawl.

In the evening assembly, after Swamishri had been honoured with garlands the kishores narrated incidents about Swamishri’s care and love for them. Thereafter a video was presented on Swamishri. Then the kishores performed a cultural dance and lastly they sang, “Bhulish hu jagatni mãyã.” Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “The kishores performed a cultural dance before us. We have seen the cultural values they have been exposed to. Today we find that the (social and cultural) climate is going awry. It is therefore painful to see the offtrack lives of children, teenagers and youths. Yogiji Maharaj, however, thought of inspiring character in the lives of children and youths so that they could walk the path of goodness, please their parents, walk the path of bhakti and dharma and through such cultural performances be blessed with moksha. Today that inspiration of Yogiji Maharaj has reached many places in India and America.” Swamishri blessed the invited guests: Former Mayor of Chino Hills, Gary Larson; Planning Commissioner of Chino Hills Art Bennett, County Councilman of Chino Hills, Peter Rogers; Director of Mystic India, Keith Melton; Chino Hills Public Work Commissioner, Barry Fischer and industrialist Suru Manek.

A spiritual seeker's brother believed he was possessed. Blessing him, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "There is nothing at all. It is all in the mind. So drive it out of your mind and chant, Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan..."

A youth came for darshan. His wife had recently committed suicide along with their children. His father in law understood that this youth was not at fault. So the father in law himself came forward to console him and said, "You do not need to worry about anything. We are with you. We have no objection even if you marry again."

Despite so much support, whenever he remembers this event, there is only restlessness in this youth's heart. As he told Pramukh Swami Maharaj about it, he broke down in tears. Consoling him, Swamishri said, "You are not at fault. Such must have been her destiny! So do not worry. Pray for her soul to find peace, do bhajan and get on with your business or job. Practise satsang properly. Do not worry. We will pray to Shriji Maharaj."

Talk turned to Dashrathsinh, a director from Rajkot. After a recent accident he had been suffering from knee pain for about four months. With Swamishri's permission, he had gone to Mumbai and had an operation. In this context Yogiswarup Swami said, "Along with his Jai Swaminarayan, he has sent word asking that satsang may take root in his soul."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj immediately said, "For Dashrathsinh it is already firm. His knowledge, devotion and understanding are firm. So he is not one to become unhappy because of the body."

In the evening, Pramukh Swami Maharaj spoke on the phone with Hiten Mehta (London). He is Prince Charles's secretary for charitable matters and is a staunch satsangi. Swamishri said to Hiten, "You have a connection with Prince Charles!"
Hiten said, "There I am only doing a job, but my true relationship is with you."
Swamishri immediately said, "That is true. The true relationship is with God. That is a worldly matter."

BAPS Vidhya Mandir- Sarangpur, celebrated Guru Bhakti din on September 9th 2010 in the divine presence of Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
The Day Began with the worship of Swamibapa. The Students presented a 35 minute programme on “Mara Swami..” which contained dances and discussions.

Today, in the conversation during the midday meal, there was an account of how well wishers had cooperated in the tribute assemblies held on Swamibapa's passing to Akshardham, and of the unimaginable responses received.
Hearing this, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "This is a miracle, isn't it, what else?!" Then he added, "In miracles one can get trapped; this is devotion..."
At that time the sadhus asked, "All these who served will be liberated, won't they?"
"No need to ask, heaps of liberation. They did seva at the right time," Swamishri exclaimed in a transcendent mood.

ds.t: Serving dudhpak with his own hands
w: Today, on the occasion of Shastriji Maharaj's memorial day, it had been planned that Mahant Swami Maharaj would serve the sadhus after he had eaten. But Swamishri himself expressed the wish, "I want to serve the sadhus first." The mechanism (device) that had been prepared was quickly set up, so that Swamishri would have less strain in serving.
Swamishri said, "No. Not like this. I want to serve with my own hands."

Swamishri took a golden coloured jug in his hand. One jug would fill perhaps one and three quarter or two bowls! So the jug had to be refilled again and again. And then the jug had to be lifted to pour dudhpak (sweet milk and rice pudding) into each bowl, so the strain was considerable. But ignoring all that, Swamishri, very pleased, was serving dudhpak while meeting each sadhu with his glance and his smile. As always, Swamishri's compassion won over the strain he had to bear.

His attendant, Munichintandas Swami, was supporting the jug so that Swamishri would feel less tired, but in doing so a few drops of dudhpak were falling onto the low table placed below. Swamishri did not like this. With a little displeasure he said, "He just likes spilling."
The attendant sadhu laughed and said, "But Swami! That much will spill anyway. That is why the table has been placed below."
But just a few seconds later, he lovingly said to Munichintandas Swami, "Change hands if you want to. It must be feeling cold."
The dudhpak was cold. Swamishri had also noticed that Munichintandas Swami had been supporting it constantly with the same hand.
Swamishri shapes us both with a pat of love and with a tap of correction.

Three sadhus from LA were leaving today. A sadhus' conference was to be held towards the end of the America tour, and these sadhus would not be able to come to it. The sadhus requested Swamishri, "Swami! Please tell us the essence of this sadhus' conference."
Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Seeing divinity." After a while, he added, "Seeing divinity, unity and humility."
The essence of a three day conference in three words!!

After his meal, Swamishri encouraged the youths from the North East region who wish to become sadhus: “You have made a very big resolve. In the army you cross over once. This is wrestling for your whole life. In this wrestling Maharaj, Yogibapa and Pramukh Swami Maharaj are with you, so you will have no difficulty. This is not the path of a wandering ascetic. This is Pramukh Swami’s path. You are on a very good path. As your understanding grows, you will see it.”
How much strength these words hold!
